author: Antonio Clim
article: Which Firms Make the List? Technology Measurement under Fixed Screening Capacity
known_exposure: All H3-H6 outcomes, model yields and country failures have been inspected. H7 ideas use this knowledge. No new H7 acquisition, nested-selection, sector-fixed or capacity-equivalent empirical results computed before this lock. This is retrospective protocol-locked exploratory analysis, not prospective external confirmation.
cohort: H4 matched planning; primary N=13996, full N=14363; original H1 planning labels fixed BEFORE adoption matching; no new eligibility or relabelling. This conditions on observed valid technology/adoption; not evidence about missing-technology population.
features: B and B_MOST5 exactly H4 (routine sector, start year, multi-establishment, foreign ownership; no sales/employment/source/country predictors). MOST5 is one categorical response with five states, not five questions. Target query decisions use B scores and positive weights only, never target technology/outcomes.
primary_model: H4 L2 logistic C1 lbfgs max_iter2000 tol1e-8; H4 train-only preprocessing/fixed domains; equal-country/equal-source India fitting weights sum=Ntrain.
sensitivity_model: H5 fixed gini tree max_depth3 min_samples_leaf50 random_state20261105, other settings unchanged. Same planning cohort. No learner selection by results.
band_rule: For r>0 descending B-score cumulative weighted probability interval [q*(1-r),q+(1-q)*r]; query every complete exact-score block with strictly positive intersection. r=0 queries nobody, r=1 everybody. Entire B ties included, actual weighted/unweighted query burden reported and may exceed nominal r.
contact_rule: No-query allocation exactly B. Outside queried pool retain each original B contact probability. Inside pool rerank by rich score to the same B expected weighted contact mass in that pool. Full-query allocation exactly B_MOST5. Uniform fractional tie probabilities; no firm-ID or outcome tiebreak. Querying changes neither eligibility nor total expected weighted contact quota.

nested_selection.outer: Leave one of 11 reporting countries out; both India sources excluded together. Secondary sources evaluated after training/selection on all 11 primary countries, never used for training or selection.
nested_selection.inner: Within each outer-training-country set, hold one validation country out, fit both models on the rest; never fit imputation/scaling/model/selector on outer target. Evaluate each menu band per validation source at same q; average India sources within country then equal countries. For secondary selector use 11 inner folds.
nested_selection.objective: For each quota/model separately select smallest nominal r whose inner equal-country yield >= full-query inner equal-country yield - 0.25 cases per 100 expected weighted contacts. r=0 eligible; r=1 always qualifies. Tie by smaller r. No target scores/outcomes/technology used to choose r. The 0.25 tolerance is design input, not equivalence, non-inferiority or guaranteed held-out loss bound.
nested_selection.fit_reuse: A model fitted excluding the same unordered country pair may be reused in both corresponding inner folds. Fitting sample and weights identical; prediction/evaluation target differs. Record all fits, hashes and inner results.

random_comparator.role: Secondary paired Monte Carlo comparator; not selector candidate.
random_comparator.rule: For each outer source/model/quota generate 256 independent Bernoulli query masks with p equal to actual weighted query fraction of selected band. Seed deterministically from master seed plus source/model/quota/replicate, independent of outcomes/technology. Apply same pool reranking and outside-B rule. This matches expected query-weight and expected firm-count budget to probability p; realised budget and yield reported per replicate. It does not exactly match realised band firm count. No global B/rich policy lottery substituted.
random_comparator.report: Mean queried weighted and unweighted fractions, actual band count/mass, MC standard error for yield, sector/employment shares; mean per-replicate TV and TV of mean allocation distinguished. MC error is numerical simulation error only, not survey/sampling uncertainty.

capacity_equivalent.role: Retrospective explanatory diagnostic, not an operational rule or causal saving.
capacity_equivalent.rule: For every retained deterministic policy and source at each q, invert the fixed B-score cumulative expected case-mass curve using exact tie blocks and their event rates; use smallest/leftmost quota reaching target case mass, zero target gives zero quota. Record B inverse at its own cases, policy inverse, raw inverse(policy)-q and anchored inverse(policy)-inverse(B at q), in pp. Anchored quantity gives exactly zero for unchanged case mass and preserves adverse signs. Compare composition at policy quota q and B inverse quota. Do not invert average yields or average curves.
capacity_equivalent.limits: Target outcomes are used ex post. Equal cases may have different sector/size composition and lower yield at expanded B capacity. No monetary or staffing cost estimate; no claim future policymakers know the inverse.

sector_fixed.rule: For each sector retain exact expected weighted contact mass allocated by B at q, then rerank within sector by rich score using exact ties. Report yield and employment composition; sector composition must be unchanged. This isolates an allocation constraint comparison, not a causal decomposition or fairness guarantee.

reporting: Every source including both adverse secondary sources, all bands and both learners retained. Primary summaries average source values within India, then equal 11 countries. Primary +/− country counts, ranges, source query count/mass, absolute yield differences vs B/full, sector and employment TV, capacity-equivalent pp. No selected-best-on-target envelope, significance/equivalence or robustness claim from absence of CI. Without verified strata/PSUs no design-based CI. No multiplicity-free confirmation.
checks: authenticate baseline, raw and inherited inputs
endpoint and tie primitives; row-order invariance; quota accounting; ignored unqueried rich values
outer/inner country exclusion and selector provenance
independent numerical recomputation of allocations, inverses and aggregate accounting
baseline logistic/tree B and full yields match H4/H5 on exact cohort
native run from clean extracted package and exact aggregate replay
external_validation: No new untouched compatible external sample currently identified. Existing BF/Cambodia outcomes already inspected. Nested selection reduces current target leakage but cannot erase retrospective researcher choice. No prospective claim.
data_and_release: Private analysis only. No raw CSV, firm identifiers or row prediction/allocation vectors saved or redistributed. Protocol, source, aggregate results, environment, receipts and audit retained. H6 manuscript/kits unchanged until subsequent phase. No public upload/submission/DOI/cost/GitHub Actions.
